links.outcome: Moderate-to-severe postoperative pain and adverse reactions with AQI-guided performance monitoring
links.effect: Control versus AQI: pain 26.3% vs. 21.7%; ratio difference -4.6% (95% CI, -6% to -3.2%; P < 0.001). Total adverse events: 18.1% vs. 19.2%; P = 0.09.
links.quote: The incidence of moderate-to-severe pain was 26.3% in the control group and 21.7% in the experimental group.
